Chess engine and rules

Stockfish.js 19.0.1 is distributed under GNU GPLv3. Its JavaScript and WebAssembly assets are checked against pinned SHA-256 digests before execution. Chess rules and move validation are provided by chess.js 1.4.0 under the BSD 2-Clause License and copied into the local build.
